brat.usage:
🎨 *Brat Sticker Generator*

Generate Brat text stickers or animated stickers directly on WhatsApp.

*Command Formats:*
• *.brat <text>* — Static Brat sticker
• *.brat animated <text>* — Animated Brat sticker
• *.brat animated -d <ms> <text>* — Animated sticker with custom delay
• *.brat "animasi keren"* — Literal static text (or use ```monospace```)

*Dash Delay Options:*
• `-d 300` or `-d=300` (50–5000 ms, default 500 ms)
• `-300ms` or `-300`
• `--delay 300`

*Examples:*
• *.brat Hello World*
• *.brat animated -d 250 Hello World*
• *.brat animated 300 Hello World*
• *.brat "animasi keren"* (forces static)

_Tip: You can also reply to any message with `.brat` or `.brat animated -d 300`._
